notes.title: v1.50 PatChira - Online Multiplayer Lobby!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34773827/d27331a9c3494d453f3c38be1f18ec856362093d.png[/img]
Hello fellow YouTube lovers,

Today I added new [b]Online Mode Beta[/b] using Steam Lobby and UNet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34773827/0c88ab130efe372abfd2447037b3f96ebf6c62f8.jpg[/img]
You can create your own steam multiplayer lobby or enter someone else's.

And in Online Mode, you can watch YouTube Live Streaming with your friends.
Enjoy your happy steam life!ːsummer2019corgiː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34773827/23a8c6bf62c77cfcc03ebb72cae95a866ee517b5.jpg[/img]

Note: This is using UNet Server, so the number of limit players is 20.
Note: UNet will be gradually deprecated by Unity Technologies, so this is a limited-time mode.

notes.title: v1.10 PatChira - Steam Inventory Items!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Panchirers,

Today I released PanChira Concentration version 1.10 adding support for Steam Inventory Items.

You just obtain an item when you got a higher score.
These items are going to be used in further versions of PanChira Concentration.

notes.title: v1.02 Patch
notes.notes:
The following features have been implemented:

- Fixed an issue that the numbers of times you cleared weren't saved.
- Fixed an issue that your best global scores weren't saved.
- Fixed an issue that you were had wait for 6000 sec before the connection error occured when you cleared the game.

notes.title: Patch v1.01, A System Adjustment
notes.notes: PanChira Concentration  receives a new adjustment patch that fixes the problem increasing other players' global scores too much.

notes.notes:
